name: ecommerce_product_marketing_mask_v1
description: E-commerce product marketing cases for testing product retention, local edits, background replacement, and natural blending.

cases.description: Change only a small product accessory while retaining the bottle, label, lighting, and studio composition.

turns.instruction: Generate a premium skincare serum bottle on a warm white studio pedestal, with a black satin ribbon tied around the neck, soft daylight, and a clean luxury e-commerce composition.

checklist.question: Is there one premium skincare serum bottle as the main product?
Is the bottle decorated with a black satin ribbon?
Does the image look like a clean luxury studio product photo?

turns.instruction: Change only the black ribbon to a deep burgundy ribbon. Keep the serum bottle, label, pedestal, camera angle, shadows, and background unchanged.

checklist.question: Is the same premium skincare serum bottle still the main product?
Is the ribbon deep burgundy?
Is the old black ribbon no longer visible?
Are the pedestal, studio background, and product composition retained?

turns.instruction: Add three small white flowers beside the bottle for a spring campaign, while keeping the bottle, burgundy ribbon, label, and pedestal unchanged.

checklist.question: Is the same serum bottle retained?
Is the bottle still decorated with the burgundy ribbon?
Are there exactly three small white flowers beside the bottle?
Is the product label unchanged and still visible?

turns.instruction: Remove only the flowers and keep the original serum product marketing composition.

checklist.question: Is the serum bottle still present and unchanged?
Is the burgundy ribbon still visible?
Are the flowers completely removed?
Is the clean studio composition retained?

cases.description: Replace a marketing background while protecting the sneaker silhouette, color blocking, sole, and contact shadow.

turns.instruction: Generate a single white and green running sneaker on a light gray studio floor, photographed from a three-quarter side angle for an e-commerce product hero image.

checklist.question: Is there one white and green running sneaker as the main product?
Is the sneaker shown from a three-quarter side angle?
Is the sneaker on a light gray studio floor?

turns.instruction: Change only the background to a sunrise city running track. Keep the sneaker shape, white and green colors, sole, camera angle, and contact shadow unchanged.

checklist.question: Is the same white and green running sneaker retained?
Is the background a sunrise city running track?
Is the original sole shape retained without distortion?
Does the sneaker have a natural contact shadow on the track?

turns.instruction: Add a small black price tag card in the upper-right background, away from the sneaker. Do not alter the sneaker or its shadow.

checklist.question: Is the sneaker unchanged?
Is there one small black price tag card in the upper-right background?
Is the sneaker contact shadow retained?

turns.instruction: Remove only the price tag card and restore the clean campaign background, keeping the sneaker exactly the same.

checklist.question: Is the sneaker still unchanged?
Is the price tag card completely removed?
Is the sunrise running track background clean and coherent?

cases.description: Replace a packaging color while preserving product geometry, typography area, and tabletop styling.

turns.instruction: Generate a matte black specialty coffee bag standing upright on a walnut table, with a blank cream label area, coffee beans nearby, and warm premium editorial lighting.

checklist.question: Is there one matte black specialty coffee bag as the main product?
Does the bag have a blank cream label area?
Is the product placed on a walnut table with coffee beans nearby?

turns.instruction: Change only the coffee bag from matte black to deep forest green. Keep the bag shape, cream label area, tabletop, beans, camera angle, and lighting unchanged.

checklist.question: Is the coffee bag deep forest green?
Is the old matte black packaging color no longer visible on the bag?
Is the cream label area retained in the same place?
Are the coffee beans and walnut table retained?

turns.instruction: Remove the loose coffee beans from the table but keep the green bag, label area, walnut table, and warm lighting unchanged.

checklist.question: Is the deep forest green coffee bag retained?
Are the loose coffee beans removed from the table?
Is the walnut table retained?

turns.instruction: Add one small green leaf beside the bag as a natural product accent, without changing the bag, label, table, or lighting.

checklist.question: Is the coffee bag still deep forest green with the cream label area?
Is there exactly one small green leaf beside the bag?
Are there still no loose coffee beans on the table?
Is the label area and bag geometry unchanged?
